title: Safely managed sanitation, LDCs, LLDCs and SIDS compared with the World
headline: Safely managed sanitation: SIDS and LDCs are 15.0 points apart
subtitle: Proportion of population using an improved sanitation facility that is not shared with other households, from which excreta are safely disposed of in situ or removed and treated off-site
data_line: Data: WHO/UNICEF JMP via UN SDG Global Database, series SH_SAN_SAFE, extracted 1 Nov 2026
alt: Safely managed sanitation: SIDS and LDCs are 15.0 points apart. SIDS 42.0%, LDCs 27.0%, in 2024. SIDS 42.0%; LLDCs 32.8%; LDCs 27.0%; World 58.5%, 2024.
question: What would it take to close the gap in safely managed sanitation between Small island developing states and Least developed countries?
